ms.promise:
The results of reaching out the the community and researching royalty approaches on other chains, compiled into a brief report for easy review.
Version 2 of the CIP-102 standard, including intra-collection royalties, backwards-compatibility and improvements gathered from community feedback.
ms.criteria:
The research report should have input from Cardano community members and observations on other chains, as well as decisions made on which improvements to include.
Version 2 of the CIP-102 standard should have passed review by the CIP standards committee and been merged into the master branch of the CIPs repository: https://github.com/cardano-foundation/CIPs
ms.report:
A. Output: Ecosystem & community research, compiled into a report
Acceptance criteria: Must have input from community, observations on other chains, decisions on improvements to be made.
Evidence: 
Research Report Published here: https://github.com/SamDelaney/CIP_102_Reference/blob/main/v2%20Research%20Report.pdf
Google Drive version: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1YOSdhVP150wF4dUMZ2QcFAFZej-yDKxL/view?usp=sharing
B. Output: Updated CIP 102 standard w/ intra-collection royalties, backwards compatibility, and community feedback results (broadly available tool calls, CIP-88 integration)
Acceptance criteria: Version 2 passed review & merged.
Evidence: 
PR: https://github.com/cardano-foundation/CIPs/pull/1177. 
Resulting subdirectory: https://github.com/cardano-foundation/CIPs/tree/master/CIP-0102.

ms.promise:
Updates all three core components of reference implementation stored in the CIP 102 folder in the CIPs repository:
・Minting a CIP 102 compliant NFT with royalties
・Reading a CIP 102 NFT’s royalties off chain
・Reading and validating against CIP 102 NFT royalties on chain

such that they comply with and demonstrate the new features outlined in CIP-102 v2.
ms.criteria: The pull request for the reference implementation has been approved and merged to master.
ms.report:
A. Output: Minting a CIP 102 compliant NFT with royalties
Acceptance criteria: The pull request for the reference implementation has been approved and merged to master.
Evidence: https://github.com/SamDelaney/CIP_102_Reference/pull/2 has been merged to main. It includes the 'mint-collection' command here which lets you mint a collection with v2 royalty flags.
More information on how to test this can be found in the README. 
B. Output: Reading a CIP 102 NFT’s royalties off chain
Acceptance criteria: The pull request for the reference implementation has been approved and merged to master.
Evidence: https://github.com/SamDelaney/CIP_102_Reference/pull/2 has been merged to main. It includes the 'get-royalties' command here which reads & prints a royalty datum based on its collection and v2 royalty flag.
More information on how to test this can be found in the README as well. 
C. Output: Reading and validating against CIP 102 NFT royalties on chain
Acceptance criteria: The pull request for the reference implementation has been approved and merged to master.
Evidence: https://github.com/SamDelaney/CIP_102_Reference/pull/2 has been merged to main. It includes an update to the onchain validators' royalty parsing here, and tests here confirming the updated functionality.
More information on this can be found in the onchain-reference README.

・Onchain Validation Implementation

Project close out report & video.

Close out assets (report & video) have been submitted to the catalyst team.
ms.report:
A. Output: Update 3-5 existing open-source libraries which support CIP-102 to also support CIP-102 v2. These libraries should be the same ones as selected as part of the funded work for CIP-102 v1 unless a switch is requested by the community.
Acceptance criteria: The PR to each selected library has been made, approved & merged.
Evidence:
・Mintun.io: Mintun implements CIP-88 as consistent with the CIP-102 v2 implementation. The source code for CIP-88 specifically can be found open-source here.
・Python Implementation: Finalized contributions to PyCardano to capture the Python developer community.
・Prerequisite: CIP-67 Support - fixed in: https://github.com/theeldermillenial/pycardano/pull/4
・CIP-102 v2 support added in: https://github.com/bloxbean/cardano-client-lib/pull/627
・Java Implementation: Integrated support into the cardano-client-lib to enable Java and JVM-based developers. 
・Prerequisite: Gradle v8.0 - fixed in: https://github.com/Python-Cardano/pycardano/pull/490
・CIP-102 v2 support added in: https://github.com/Python-Cardano/pycardano/pull/491

B. Output: Project Closeout Video
Acceptance criteria: Close out assets (report & video) have been submitted to the catalyst team.
Evidence: https://youtu.be/wHvybIGOnTQ
